name: Cat Cat
summary: Walk the village Vietnam Tourism says you can see without a guide. The scenic fee at the waterfall and the gate ticket are different charges, and the pages do not agree on the child’s height or the closing time. Go in daylight. How long to allow on the path is Check on arrival.
fee: Check on arrival. Scenic fee and village gate are different.
getThere: Walk or a short ride from town. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The water wheel, the field, and the boardwalk at Cat Cat

notice.title: The waterfall fee is not the gate
notice.body: From 1 January 2025 the scenic fee for Thác Cát Cát is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. The village gate is a different ticket. Do not add the two together.

body: Cat Cat is the closest of the community walks named since 2005. The village site prints both thôn Cát Cát, xã Tả Van, and San Sả Hồ commune. The 2025 xã Tả Van absorbed xã Hoàng Liên, which is where the scenic-fee decision still places the waterfall. You can walk it without a guide, on the Vietnam Tourism page. The village site lists performance slots and does not describe the path.

The performances on that site are 9:00–9:40, 10:00–10:40, 11:00–11:40, 14:00–14:40, 15:00–15:40, 16:00–16:40, and 17:00–17:40. A visit length for the walk itself is Check on arrival. The houses, the path, and a pond sit under the cloud on the slope above the wheel.

Keep the gate and the scenic fee apart. Two commercial pages print 150,000 đồng for an adult at the gate. One prints a child from 1 m to under 1.4 m at 70,000 đồng. The other prints 1 m–1.3 m at 70,000 đồng. The town decision for the gate is Check on arrival. Under 1 m is free on the first of those pages.

figures.caption: Houses, the path, and a pond under the cloud
figures.alt: Cat Cat houses and a pond on a terraced slope in fog

gettingThere: The village is the short trip from the church, on foot or by a ride. No official minute count was on the pages. Check on arrival. The waterfall is inside the same walk, and it has its own scenic fee.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Walk or take a short ride. The minutes are Check on arrival.

hours: Village site: 06:30–18:00, and also 07:00–18:00. A commercial page: 6:30–17:30. Performance slots run through the day at the times above.
closed: Check the gate board. The three closing times do not match.
admissionNote: Scenic fee for Thác Cát Cát from 1 January 2025: 10,000 đồng from age 16, 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Village gate, commercial pages only: adult 150,000 đồng. Child 70,000 đồng from 1 m to under 1.4 m on one page, or from 1 m to 1.3 m on the other. Do not merge the scenic fee and the gate into one price.
